description: This file contains unit tests for the RoundRobinSelector class, verifying its behavior in resource selection scenarios including distribution, duplicate handling, and infinite loop prevention.

classes.name: RoundRobinSelectorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the RoundRobinSelector resource selection logic.

methods.name: NextSelectionWillGoThroughEveryResourceIfExistingSelectionEmptyTest
methods.description: Tests that the resource selector cycles through all resources when starting with an empty selection.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontGoInfinitelyTest
methods.description: Ensures that the resource selector does not enter an infinite loop during selection.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelectionsTest
methods.description: Verifies that the resource selector does not reselect already selected resources.

methods.name: NextSelectionWontReSelectExistingSelectionsWithDuplicatesTest
methods.description: Tests that the resource selector handles duplicate resources correctly without reselecting the same resource multiple times.
